messages:
sam: FYI saw a recurring pattern: fractional slices burst -> host NIC saturation -> cross-host retries -> cascade evictions. happened twice in eu-west-2c this morning.

odin: Any packet stats?

sam: quick snip:
```
[2026-09-02T09:01:12Z] host=eu-west-2c-112 nic_util=92% tx_retrans=280 preempt=tenant=xpress reason=egress_congest
```

rhea: Looks like warm-pool spill is amplifying the problem. spilling increases cross-host egress which increases NIC load and retransmits.

mike: Suggestion: implement a "foxhole" clamp that is host-local. when nic_util>85% and tenant burst>threshold we: 1) reduce outbound concurrency for that slice, 2) force local-quantized fallback, 3) emit a degraded-mode response so SDKs can backoff.

odin: That avoids full eviction and keeps cache warm locally. need per-host mem+egress budget so we don't hoard resources.

rhea: Also add tenant opt-out for enterprise and a metric host.foxhole_clamp{tenant}.

mike: Rollout plan: canary 8 hosts eu-west-2c 4h -> expand. monitors: host.nic_util, tx_retrans, allocator.preempt_count, p99-gen-latency. infra-bot create experiment?

infra-bot: experiment created by mike: foxhole-egress-clamp v1 -> canary(eu-west-2c 8 hosts, 4h). monitors=[host.nic_util, tx_retrans, allocator.preempt_count, host.foxhole_clamp].

sam: Cool. I'll run a replay sim against last 72h bursts and post numbers. tagging @oncall for the 06:00 UTC watch window. :mag:
